column3: “Plan” is rendered “scheme,” and “at the light of the morning” “When morning comes.”

“Lift up a saying” is rendered “take up … a taunt”; “wail a wailing, it is finished” is rendered “utter a bitter lamentation,” and NASB places “We are completely destroyed!” first. “For me” is rendered “from me.”
“Casts a measuring-line” is rendered “stretching a measuring line”; NASB supplies “For you.”
“Prophesy” (literally “drip”) is rendered “speak out”; NASB renders the second half as a condition. The meaning is uncertain.
“Is it short, the spirit” is rendered “Is the Spirit … impatient?”; “is it said” is rendered “Is it being said.”
“Yesterday” is rendered “Recently”; “from in front of a garment a mantle” is rendered “the robe off the garment,” and “security” “unsuspecting.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Drive out” is rendered “evict,” and “glory” “splendor”; NASB adds “Each one.”
“Because it has become unclean it will destroy” is rendered “Because of the uncleanness that brings on destruction.”
“Prophesy” is rendered “speak out,” and “strong drink” “liquor”; NASB supplies “and said.”
NASB reverses the verbs “gather” and “assemble”; “a sheepfold” is rendered “in the fold,” and “distraught from humankind” “noisy with men.”
